sources.title: FP8-RL: A Practical and Stable Low-Precision Stack for LLM Reinforcement Learning
sources.snippet: Reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models (LLMs) is increasingly bottlenecked by rollout (generation), where long output sequence lengths make attention and KV-cache memory dominate end-to-end step time. sources.title: YouZhi: Towards High-Concurrency Financial LLMs via Adaptive GQA-to-MLA Transition
sources.snippet: Large language models (LLMs) drive significant financial innovations, yet their high-concurrency deployment is severely bottlenecked by KV cache memory overhead, which inflates infrastructure costs and throttles scalability. To address this, we propose YouZhi-LLM, a highly efficient financial LLM empowered by a comprehensive structural transition and training pipeline natively built on the Huawei Ascend ecosystem.
